subject: Mobile Development
title: Foldable Phones: The New Form Factor
description: A 60-second lesson on Foldable Phones: The New Form Factor.

hook.text: Samsung's Galaxy Fold unfolds into a tablet-sized screen that fits in your pocket.

buildup.text: Foldable displays use ultra-thin glass and flexible OLED panels that bend without breaking.

discovery.text: Foldables give users a large screen for productivity and a compact size for portability.

twist.text: After years of hype, foldables remain under 2% of the smartphone market due to high prices.

climax.text: Foldables solve a real problem but need to become affordable before they go mainstream.

punchline.text: Big screens that fold small — if you can afford one.

quiz.question: Why haven't foldable phones gone mainstream yet?
options: They remain too expensive for most consumers
